title: Site Import
subtitle: Bring a site here from any panel: its files, its database, and the configuration that connects the two.
note: Each step works on its own. Run only the ones you need, in any order.

archive.title: 1. Site files
archive.description: Upload a zip, tar, tar.gz, tar.bz2, tar.xz or rar archive. It is analysed first; nothing is written until you confirm.
archive.skipRoot: Skip the container directory "{{root}}" so the site lands directly in the destination
archive.cleanDest: Empty the destination directory first. This permanently deletes everything already there.

warnings.empty: The archive appears to be empty.
warnings.no_container_root: The archive has several entries at its root, so there is no single container directory to skip.
warnings.strip_unavailable: This server cannot skip a container directory for this archive format. Extract it whole and move the files afterwards.

database.title: 2. Database
database.description: Upload a .sql or .sql.gz dump into one of this domain's databases. A gzip file is detected by its content, whatever it is named.
database.truncate: Drop every table in the target database first. This permanently deletes the data already there.

config.title: 3. Application configuration
config.description: Point the imported application at its new database. Without this the files and data are in place but the site still reports a database connection error.
config.none: No wp-config.php or .env was found in that directory.

notes.no_plain_constants: The database settings are not written as plain values (they may come from getenv or a variable). Update this file by hand.
notes.write_failed: The file could not be written.

errors.uploadFailed: The archive could not be uploaded.
errors.extractFailed: The archive could not be extracted.
errors.importFailed: The dump could not be imported.
errors.configFailed: The configuration could not be updated.
